cards.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_membership_status_id ON membership (status_id);
verification_queries: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'membership' AND indexname = 'idx_membership_status_id';
